prompt_md: A lift can carry either 10 adults or 20 children. If 6 adults are already in it, how many children can still get in?
prompt_short: A lift takes 10 adults or 20 children. 6 adults in. Children who fit?
hint_md: How many children take up the room of one adult?
explain_intuition_md: There's room for 4 more adults, and every adult's space fits two children. So 4 adult places make room for 8 children.
